title: Missing probability on a pair of branches
source: Theory IGCSE-24.1 Quick check 1; the probabilities on branches from one point add to 1
stem: On a tree diagram, the two branches for whether a train is late at a station have probabilities \({p|raw}\) (late) and \(x\) (not late). Find \(x\).

steps.name: K
steps.text_tex: The branches from one point show all the outcomes, so \({p|raw}+x=1\)
steps.note: Probabilities on branches from the same point add to 1.

contexts.note: Includes the original late 0.3, not late 0.7

contexts.stem: The probability that it rains on a given day is \({p|raw}\). On a tree diagram, find the probability written on the branch for 'no rain'.
A biased spinner lands on red with probability \({p|raw}\); otherwise it lands on blue. Write down the probability on the 'blue' branch of a tree diagram.

title: Number of outcomes for two stages
source: Theory IGCSE-24.1 Quick check 2; m branches then k branches give m x k outcomes
stem: A spinner with \({m|int}\) equal sections is spun and then a fair dice with \({k|int}\) faces is rolled. A tree diagram is drawn to show all the possible outcomes. How many outcomes are there at the end of the tree?

steps.name: K
steps.text_tex: Each of the \({m|int}\) first branches splits into \({k|int}\) branches
steps.note: Multiply the numbers of branches at each stage.

contexts.stem: A café offers \({m|int}\) starters and \({k|int}\) main courses. A tree diagram shows every choice of one starter followed by one main course. How many different meals are shown?

Bag P holds \({m|int}\) different coloured counters and bag Q holds \({k|int}\) different coloured counters. One counter is taken from P and then one from Q. How many end points does the tree diagram of outcomes have?

tags.topic: Probability using tree diagrams and Venn diagrams

title: Number of outcomes for three stages
source: Theory IGCSE-24.1 Quick check 3; a x b x c outcomes
stem: An experiment has three stages, with \({a|int}\), \({b|int}\) and \({c|int}\) possible outcomes at the first, second and third stages. How many outcomes are shown at the end of a full tree diagram?

steps.name: K
steps.text_tex: \({a|int}\) branches, each splitting into \({b|int}\), each splitting into \({c|int}\)
steps.note: Multiply the numbers of branches at each stage.

contexts.note: Includes the original three coins, 8 outcomes

contexts.stem: On a journey there are three sets of traffic lights with \({a|int}\), \({b|int}\) and \({c|int}\) possible signals respectively. How many end points does a tree diagram of all the possible signals have?
A quiz has three questions with \({a|int}\), \({b|int}\) and \({c|int}\) answer choices. A tree diagram shows every way of answering all three questions. How many ways are shown?
